name: Trident of the Helldukes
body:
School evocation; Level: magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

Components: V,S,M (a small trident made of brass)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: 0 ft.

Effect: a two-handed brass trident

Duration: 1 round/level (D)

Saving Throw: See below; Spell Resistance: no

A two-handed, barbed, magic trident of steel-hard, reddish brass appears in your hand, which only you can use. You are considered proficient with the weapon. The trident counts as a magic reach weapon with a +2 enhancement bonus, inflicts 1d8 damage, and criticals on a 20/x2. On a critical hit, the painful barbs sink into the target, hampering it as it tries to free itself and reducing its movement by 10 ft. for one round.
